word-connectbyconfig: Allow client connect by config file
word-copyhttpproxy: Click to copy HTTP proxy address
word-copysocks5proxy: Click to copy SOCKS5 proxy address
info-autogenerated: Unique, non-filling will be generated automatically
info-timelimit: Fill freely, automatically recognized. Leave empty to disable. For example: 2025-01-01 or 2025-01-01 00:00:00 +0800 CST
info-casefile: Provide a local file service accessible to the public network, which can only be started by the client using the profile mode.
info-casehttpproxy: Use port 8004 of public server 1.1.1.1 as HTTP proxy to visit intranet site.
info-casep2p: The traffic does not pass through the public network server, which is greatly affected by the NAT type, and cannot guarantee 100% success. Most NAT types are supported. A client is also required to provide a port for access to the access side.
info-casesecret: There is no need to add a new port to access port 22 of intranet server 10.1.50.2, which can prevent other people from connecting. A client is also required to provide a port for access to the access side.
info-casesocks5: Use port 8003 of public server 1.1.1.1 as Socks5 proxy to access any device or resource in the Intranet.
info-casemixproxy: Use port 8003 of public server 1.1.1.1 as HTTP/Socks5 proxy to access any device or resource in the Intranet.
info-casetcp: Connect port 8001 of public server 1.1.1.1 to port 22 of Intranet machine 10.1.50.101 to realize SSH connection.
info-caseudp: Through port 53 of public server 1.1.1.1, access port 53 of Intranet machine 10.1.50.101, and use DNS service.
info-createaccount: Create account to see it in action.
info-header: Colon separated, multiple lines please fill in
info-destacl: When whitelist/blacklist is enabled, SOCKS5 does not support UDP (UDP Associate will be disabled).
info-destaclrules: One per line: IP, CIDR, hostname, or wildcard domain (e.g. *.example.com).
info-httpsjustproxy: Route by domain (SNI). No TLS decryption here; traffic is forwarded unchanged to the backend. Note: with HTTP/2 backends, browsers may reuse a connection and cause misrouting.
info-tlsoffload: Route by domain (SNI); handle only the TLS handshake, then forward the decrypted data to the backend.
info-feature1: Comprehensive protocol support, compatible with almost all commonly used protocols, such as tcp, udp, http(s), socks5, p2p, http proxy ...
info-feature2: Full platform compatibility (linux, windows, macos, Qunhui, etc.), support installation as a system service simply.
info-feature3: Comprehensive control, both client and server control are allowed.
info-feature4: Https integration, support to convert backend proxy and web services to https, and support multiple certificates.
info-feature5: Just simple configuration on web ui can complete most requirements.
info-feature6: Complete information display, such as traffic, system information, real-time bandwidth, client version, etc.
info-feature7: Powerful extension functions, everything is available (cache, compression, encryption, traffic limit, bandwidth limit, port reuse, etc.)
info-feature8: Domain name resolution has functions such as custom headers, 404 page configuration, host modification, site protection, URL routing, and pan-resolution.
info-feature9: Multi-user and user registration support on server.
info-flowreset: Clear current traffic statistics when selected
info-onlyproxy: Only socks5 , web, HTTP forward proxy
info-tagline: A lightweight, high-performance, powerful intranet reverse proxy server
info-targettunnel: Can only fill in ports if it is local machine proxy, only tcp supports load balancing
info-targetauth: Leave the password authentication blank to disable it
info-pemtext: Supports entering the certificate path or certificate text content (drag-and-drop supported). The certificate file format should be: xxxx.pem
info-pemkey: Supports entering the private key path or private key text content (drag-and-drop supported). The private key file format should be: xxxx.key
info-urlrewrite: Path rewrite prefix (leave blank to disable)
